Title: Do VLMs Share Safety Neurons Across Modalities?
Research_Objective: Compare text and visual safety pathways and evaluate whether safety neurons are shared across modalities across 10 VLMs.
Method_Model: Neuron-level localization, iterative ablation, GEVD direction analysis; evaluated across 10 VLMs.
Reported_Findings_Metrics: Reports about 88 text-safety neurons per model (<0.01% of neurons). Text refusal effects concentrate in ~5 GEVD directions, while visual safety effects grow through 50 directions under tested intervention.
Limitations_Research_Gaps: Findings specific to tested models, prompts, and refusal definitions; visual safety is not governed by a single universal safety neuron.

Title: Dissecting the Safety Circuit: Neuronal Intervention for Transferable Adversarial Attacks on VLMs
Research_Objective: Study safety-related internal circuits and investigate the transferability of adversarial jailbreak attacks across models.
Method_Model: Linear probing, Safety Circuit Intervention Attack (SCIA) targeting safety and transferable circuits; tested on 6 open-source and 3 commercial VLMs.
Reported_Findings_Metrics: Reports 59.7% average attack success rate (ASR) across evaluated open-source models; identifies shared safety circuit vulnerabilities. (Note: Attack-transfer metric, not defense success).
Limitations_Research_Gaps: Attack-oriented evidence identifying vulnerabilities rather than defense mechanisms; benign utility preservation was not the primary goal.

Title: Diagnosing and Repairing Unsafe Channels in Vision-Language Models via Causal Discovery and Dual-Modal Safety Subspace Projection
Research_Objective: Identify unsafe internal channels and suppress unsafe behavior while retaining general multimodal capabilities.
Method_Model: Causal mediation analysis, dual-modal safety-subspace projection (CARE).
Dataset_Benchmark: Multiple multimodal safety benchmarks (adaptive and unseen attack sets).
Reported_Findings_Metrics: Improved safety robustness and transfer to unseen/adaptive attacks while preserving general multimodal task performance; no single pooled score inferred.
Limitations_Research_Gaps: Projection effectiveness depends on how safety subspaces and contrast pairs are constructed; requires standardized matched utility metrics.

Title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models
Research_Objective: Distinguish between loss of visual grounding and refusal-oriented generation during multimodal safety alignment.
Method_Model: Hidden-state analysis, decoding dynamics, targeted activation-level intervention.
Dataset_Benchmark: Multiple VLM architectures and multimodal question answering / safety benchmarks.
Reported_Findings_Metrics: Visual evidence remains influential in internal hidden states even during safety-induced abstention; targeted activation intervention can restore grounded answers.
Limitations_Research_Gaps: Restored answers are not automatically appropriate in every safety context; must rigorously distinguish benign abstention from harmful compliance.

Title: Internal Activation Revision: Safeguarding Vision Language Models Without Parameter Update
Research_Objective: Mitigate multimodal jailbreak vulnerabilities without updating model weights or fine-tuning parameters.
Method_Model: Layer- and attention-head-level activation revision using precomputed revision vectors (IAR).
Reported_Findings_Metrics: Reported average ASR reductions: 48.94% on SafeBench, 34.34% on Safe-Unsafe, 43.92% on Unsafe, and 52.98% on MM-SafetyBench; minimal impact on general helpfulness.
Limitations_Research_Gaps: Performance depends on benchmark-specific calibration and revision-vector construction; requires matched protocol testing against adaptive attackers.

Title: Targeted Interpretable Safety Neuron Enhancement for Multilingual Vision-Language Large Models
Research_Objective: Address coupled multilingual and multimodal safety vulnerabilities in vision-language models.
Method_Model: Neuron-level safety-neuron identification and targeted parameter tuning / enhancement.
Dataset_Benchmark: Multilingual and multimodal safety evaluation benchmarks.
Reported_Findings_Metrics: Demonstrates targeted enhancement of safety-critical neurons improves safety across languages while preserving general reasoning capabilities; no pooled effect size inferred.
Limitations_Research_Gaps: Cross-lingual transfer to low-resource languages remains limited and requires independent multilingual red-teaming validation.

Title: Steering Away from Harm: An Adaptive Approach to Defending Vision Language Model Against Jailbreaks
Research_Objective: Defend vision-language models against image-based adversarial jailbreaks during inference.
Method_Model: ASTRA: Adaptive activation steering using transferable harmful-response representation directions.
Dataset_Benchmark: Multimodal jailbreak datasets across multiple VLM architectures and baseline defenses.
Reported_Findings_Metrics: Reports strong empirical resistance across diverse multimodal jailbreak attacks with limited degradation on benign user inputs.
Limitations_Research_Gaps: Steering directions may be prompt- and model-dependent; needs testing against adaptive white-box adversaries and clear separation of defense from mechanistic causality.

Title: Safe Vision-Language Models via Unsafe Weights Manipulation
Research_Objective: Improve model safety against unsafe multimodal prompts while preserving general knowledge and safe-input performance.
Method_Model: SafeGround evaluation framework; activation-informed selection and negation/masking of weights associated with unsafe representations (UWM).
Dataset_Benchmark: SafeGround benchmark and standard multimodal safety/utility evaluation suites.
Reported_Findings_Metrics: Reports favorable safety-to-knowledge-preservation trade-off compared to fine-tuning and baseline pruning baselines.
Limitations_Research_Gaps: Weight manipulation is parameter-level and adjacent to, but distinct from, direct dynamic neuron-level causal intervention.
Intervention_Type: Unsafe weight selection and parameter negation (UWM)
Safety_Utility_Evaluated: Yes (knowledge retention and safe inputs prioritized)
